prompt_md: A square lawn is 10 m on each side. A path 1 m wide runs all the way around the outside of it. What's the area of the path, in square metres?
prompt_short: 10 m square lawn with a 1 m path around it. Path area?
explain_intuition_md: Four 10 m strips give 40, but the path also has a 1 m square at each corner. The outer square is 12 m on a side.
